metaDescription: Farm partnership opportunities reviewed by FarmExit. Applications are non-binding until FarmExit coordinates next steps.
title: Partnership marketplace
description: Farm owners publish partnership opportunities. FarmExit reviews each opportunity before it appears here. Applications are non-binding expressions of interest.
notLiveBody: Partnership requests and applications are supported for signed-in farm owners and applicants, but there is no approved public API to list published partnership opportunities on this website.
nonBindingNote: When public discovery launches, applications will remain non-binding expressions of interest coordinated by FarmExit.
trustNote: Sample opportunities shown for layout review until public partnership discovery APIs are available.

vegetable.title: Vegetable production partnership
vegetable.requirements: Individual or company applicants with agricultural operations experience.

dates.title: Date palm orchard partnership
dates.requirements: Company applicants preferred; audited accounts required in the application.

livestock.title: Mixed crop & livestock partnership
livestock.requirements: Partners with livestock management track record.
